# Barro Kitchens

> Barro Kitchens, by Barro Industries OPC, designs, builds, delivers and installs stainless-steel commercial kitchens and equipment, built to order, from its base in Quezon City, Metro Manila, Philippines. The business has been running for 23 years and began as a family business in Baguio City and La Union.

Barro Kitchens builds kitchens for restaurants, cafés, hotels, hospitals, schools and laboratories, commissary kitchens, government institutions and homes. It works end to end: consultation and site visit, design and layout, fabrication, delivery, installation and commissioning, then after-sales support. Every piece is built to your exact dimensions, with seams welded and ground smooth and surfaces polished to a professional finish. Barro Industries OPC is the registered company behind the Barro Kitchens name.

Key facts:
- Materials: food-grade SS304 stainless steel as standard; laboratory-grade SS316 on request.
- Construction: made-to-order tables, sinks and stoves have a 1.5 mm (16 gauge) top plate; bodies and shelving 1.2 mm; square-tube posts with adjustable bullet feet.
- Finishes: hairline as standard; brushed, mirror or satin on request.
- Registrations: PhilGEPS-registered, SEC-registered and VAT-registered.
- Warranty: a 12-month warranty on workmanship. Full-kitchen projects can add 12 months of preventive maintenance service (PMS) with KitchenShield™.
- Prices are not published. The online quote request shows an estimated range for your selection, and the final quotation is sent after review. No account is needed.

## Services
- [Services overview](https://barroindustries.com/services/): the six services and how a project runs
- [Commercial and commissary kitchen fit-outs](https://barroindustries.com/services/commercial-kitchen-fit-out/): design-build from concept to completion, one contractor from drawings to commissioning
- [Stainless-steel and metal fabrication](https://barroindustries.com/services/stainless-steel-fabrication/): work tables, sinks, cabinets, shelving and racks, plus railings, gates, structural and sheet-metal work to your drawing
- [Exhaust and fresh-air systems](https://barroindustries.com/services/exhaust-and-fresh-air-systems/): range hoods, ducting and blowers that remove heat, smoke and grease
- [Fresh-air systems](https://barroindustries.com/services/fresh-air-systems/): supply air that replaces what the exhaust removes
- [LPG gas line installation](https://barroindustries.com/services/lpg-gas-line-installation/): a centralised, fully welded gas line from an external tank farm to the cooking line, with leak detection and an emergency shut-off valve
- [Kitchen fire suppression](https://barroindustries.com/services/kitchen-fire-suppression/): wet chemical suppression integrated with the range hood
- [Institutional and government supply](https://barroindustries.com/services/institutional-and-government-supply/): equipment, work tables and sinks supplied and installed for schools, LGUs and government agencies through public bidding

## Products
- [Products (the catalogue)](https://barroindustries.com/catalogue/): every product in one list, in eight groups (preparation, kitchen stations, washing, ventilation, exhaust and fresh air, Chef Mode cooking equipment, storage, refrigeration), each with its standard size, key specs, options and a starting amount before VAT; the eleven stainless-steel products below have their own pages
- [Stainless-steel sinks](https://barroindustries.com/products/stainless-steel-sinks/): one to four sinks, a gooseneck or pre-rinse spray faucet, made to your size
- [Stainless-steel dish tables](https://barroindustries.com/products/stainless-steel-dish-tables/): a clean or soiled side, the dishwasher on the left or right, a pre-rinse sink and an undershelf, made to your size
- [Stainless-steel work tables](https://barroindustries.com/products/stainless-steel-work-tables/): one to three layers and up to two upper shelves, made to your size
- [Commercial gas stoves](https://barroindustries.com/products/commercial-gas-stoves/): up to six burners chosen one by one, with a griller, griddle, oven or fryer added
- [Commercial wok ranges](https://barroindustries.com/products/commercial-wok-ranges/): one to three wok holes, a rear stock burner and a swan-neck faucet, made to your size
- [Commercial griddles, grillers and fryers](https://barroindustries.com/products/commercial-griddles-grillers-and-fryers/): a griddle, lava-rock griller, fryer or griller and griddle, with one to three burners or fry baskets
- [Stainless-steel range hoods](https://barroindustries.com/products/stainless-steel-range-hoods/): a wall, island or slim canopy with baffle filters and lighting, made to your size
- [Stainless-steel cabinets](https://barroindustries.com/products/stainless-steel-cabinets/): floor-standing or wall-hung, swing or sliding doors
- [Stainless-steel shelving](https://barroindustries.com/products/stainless-steel-shelving/): one to three tiers, solid or slotted
- [Stainless-steel racks](https://barroindustries.com/products/stainless-steel-racks/): three to six tiers, with or without wheels

## Areas served
Based in Quezon City, with completed projects across Luzon, from Ilocos Sur in the north to Batangas in the south: Ilocos Sur, La Union, Baguio, La Trinidad, Tarlac, Pampanga, Bulacan, Iba (Zambales), Subic, Manila, Cavite, Laguna and Batangas.
- [Areas we serve](https://barroindustries.com/areas-we-serve/): the Luzon map and the thirteen locations

- [Commercial kitchen exhaust hood guide](https://barroindustries.com/guides/commercial-kitchen-exhaust-hood-guide/): sizing the canopy, wall, island or slim, baffle filters, ducting, the exhaust blower and fresh air
- [LPG gas line installation for restaurants](https://barroindustries.com/guides/lpg-gas-line-for-restaurants/): the cylinder cage, manifold and regulator, welded black-iron pipe, leak testing, shut-off and what to do if you smell gas
- [How to clean stainless steel kitchen equipment](https://barroindustries.com/guides/how-to-clean-and-care-for-stainless-steel/): daily and weekly cleaning, what to avoid, tea staining in humid and coastal kitchens, and SS304 vs SS316 near the sea
- [Kitchen ventilation requirements in the Philippines](https://barroindustries.com/guides/kitchen-ventilation-requirements-philippines/): what the Code on Sanitation, the Fire Code and the building office expect of kitchen exhaust, fresh air and fire suppression, and who inspects
- [Stainless steel work table guide](https://barroindustries.com/guides/stainless-steel-work-table-guide/): layers and upper shelves, length, width and height, wall-type or centre table, SS304 or SS316, finishes, care and a checklist for ordering a work table
- [Kitchen design and build process](https://barroindustries.com/guides/commercial-kitchen-design-and-build-process/): what design-build means, the six steps from consultation and site visit to after-sales support, what to bring to the first meeting, what a fit-out includes, what affects the timeline and common mistakes
- [Commercial kitchen sink guide](https://barroindustries.com/guides/commercial-kitchen-sink-guide/): what preparation, pot-wash and hand-wash sinks do, one to four bowls, drainboards and dish tables, sizing, construction, drainage and care
- [Kitchen fresh air system guide](https://barroindustries.com/guides/kitchen-fresh-air-system-guide/): why a kitchen exhaust needs makeup air, how a fresh air system works, where the intake goes, balancing exhaust and supply, comfort and upkeep
- [Custom stainless steel fabrication](https://barroindustries.com/guides/custom-stainless-steel-fabrication-guide/): what to send a fabricator, how to measure and draw, choosing SS304 or SS316 and a finish, what good welding and finishing look like, and the steps from drawing to installation
- [Kitchen exhaust problems](https://barroindustries.com/guides/kitchen-exhaust-problems/): why smoke spills past the hood, why a kitchen runs hot or smells reach the dining area, what makes grease drip or a blower noisy, and when to clean, repair or redesign
- [Commercial bakery equipment guide](https://barroindustries.com/guides/commercial-bakery-equipment-guide/): the bakery workflow, gas deck oven options, proofing cabinets, baking tables, racks and sinks, and the hood, exhaust and gas planning around the oven
- [The Kitchen Guide: areas we serve](https://barroindustries.com/guides/#areas): local guides for Quezon City, Makati and BGC, Bulacan, Pampanga, Tarlac, Zambales and Subic, Baguio and La Trinidad, La Union and Ilocos, Cavite and Laguna, and Batangas
- [The Kitchen Guide: equipment guides](https://barroindustries.com/guides/#equipment): stoves, wok ranges, griddles, fryers, grillers, steamers, sinks, racks, cabinets, stainless steel grades, thickness and finishes
- [The Kitchen Guide: ventilation and gas](https://barroindustries.com/guides/#ventilation-gas): hoods, filters, blowers, ducting, exhaust cleaning, LPG regulators and gas leak safety
- [The Kitchen Guide: by type of business](https://barroindustries.com/guides/#business): restaurants, carinderias, cloud kitchens, hotels, resorts, hospitals, schools, canteens, bakeries, cafés and more
